4                    Colour-Pink, Material-Cotton, ParentGroup-Indoors, Pricing-LOW, Product-GHT15, Collection-Indoors             NaN

import openpyxl
import re

# Load the workbook
file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/47798/1_47798_init.xlsx'
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
sheet = wb.active

# The target range is B2:B7
# The source data is in column A (A2:A7)
for row in range(2, 8):
    cell_a = sheet[f'A{row}'].value
    if cell_a:
        # Search for 'Collection-' and capture everything until the first comma or end of string
        match = re.search(r'Collection-([^,]+)', cell_a)
        if match:
            collection_name = match.group(1).strip()
            sheet[f'B{row}'].value = collection_name
        else:
            sheet[f'B{row}'].value = None
    else:
        sheet[f'B{row}'].value = None

# Save the modified workbook to the output path
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/47798_0_748ff54a/1_47798_output.xlsx'
wb.save(output_path)
